import pandas as pd
def range_problems(row):
    problems=[]
    if pd.notna(row['avg_check']) and not 50 <= row['avg_check'] <= 3000:
        problems.append('avg_check вне диапазона')
    if not 0 <= row['delivery_share'] <= 1:
        problems.append('delivery_share вне диапазона')
    if not row['visits_90d'] >= 0:
        problems.append('visits_90d отрицательное или пропуск')
    return problems
bad=P.apply(lambda row:bool(range_problems(row)),axis=1)
would_reject=bad.groupby(P['client']).mean().round(3)
app_bad=bad & P['client'].eq('app 3.2')
rejected_32=int(app_bad.sum())
first_bad=pd.to_datetime(P.loc[app_bad,'ts']).min().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
